subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Sasha / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through the Redwood demo. Really appreciated the candid conversation about your latency and cost goals and the two example flows you showed (customer support summarization and Q&A over historical policy docs). Below is a short recap and a proposed POC plan to keep momentum.

Key success criteria (what success looks like for you):
- End-to-end latency under 350ms median for single-turn chat at 1KB payloads in your staging region.
- Per-token inference cost <= $0.0008 with targeted batching/quantization applied.
- 95% accuracy on the 150-item evaluation prompt set you shared (F1 / top-1 quality measure you prefer).
- No customer data leaves your VPC during private deployment stage (audit logable).

Proposed POC outline (timeline + ownership):
1) Kickoff & data sync (Week 0, owner: Marissa + FinServ engineering) — Share sample anonymized documents and access to a staging S3 bucket.
2) Baseline demo & metrics (Week 1, owner: David) — Run initial runs against your evaluation set to capture latency, cost, and quality baseline.
3) Optimization & config (Week 2) — Apply batching, KV prefix caching, and quant profiles; iterate with you on prompts.
4) Final evaluation & handoff (Week 3) — Deliver final metrics, run regression tests, and produce an outcome summary + suggestions for production rollout.

Proposed timeline: Kickoff 2026-10-18, final report 2026-11-08. We can compress to two weeks if you want a focused short trial.

Attachments: attached is a one-page POC-outline (POC-outline.xlsx) and a POC checklist (Redwood-POC-checklist.pdf) that list infrastructure needs, accounts/roles, and test data guidance.

Open questions / asks for you:
- Can you confirm a staging S3 location and a contact who can share the evaluation prompt set?
- Any constraints on networking (IP allowlist / VPC peering) we should plan for?
- Preferred metric for quality (accuracy / BLEU / custom scoring)? We used F1 in the demo but will follow yours.

Next steps: If this plan looks good I can send a calendar invite for 30m kickoff on 2026-10-18 and loop in our solutions engineer (David) and a delivery PM.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Hi Sasha / Priya —

Quick technical answers to Sasha’s questions:

- Data residency: For the POC we can run a private deployment in your AWS account (us-east-1) using our Private package — this keeps all inference and caching inside your VPC. We will need an IAM role with limited S3 access and an API endpoint in the VPC.
- Format: CSV is easiest for the evaluation set (one prompt per row). JSONL is also fine if you have response fields.
- Networking: We typically ask for either an IP allowlist for our control-plane egress or a VPC endpoint. I attached a simple network diagram with required ports.

Proposed kickoff time: 2026-10-18 10:00am ET (2026-10-18 07:00am PT) — 30 minutes to align on access and initial runs.

Attachments: network-diagram.png

Looking forward —
David
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
